# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment documents generated for the versioned report. Use the links below as the entry point into the deeper architecture, dependency, configuration, data, API, and workflow findings.

- [api-service-contracts.md](api-service-contracts.md) - Inventory of MVC endpoints, request and response contracts, and communication patterns.
- [architecture-diagram.md](architecture-diagram.md) - Two-layer diagrams covering the application architecture and key component relationships.
- [business-workflows.md](business-workflows.md) - Business processes, rules, and the primary appointment-booking workflow.
- [configuration-inventory.md](configuration-inventory.md) - Catalog of configuration sources, settings, profiles, and sensitive configuration flows.
- [data-architecture.md](data-architecture.md) - Database configuration, entity relationships, persistence boundaries, and sensitivity notes.
- [dependency-map.md](dependency-map.md) - Categorized view of declared external dependencies and compatibility risks.
